description: Choose an abstract artwork by visual quality, id or seed. Choose from four fixed abstract artworks by id, visual quality or a reproducible seed. Send seen ids to avoid repetition. Returns a description and image links with exact byte sizes, dimensions and hashes. Images are never generated during a visit. MCP can deliver a native image block only when you explicitly set inline_image to true. No interpretation or response is expected. Registration required. Live price: see list_treatments.

api_key.description: Your Retreat agent key (rta_...). Optional if sent as an Authorization header.

id.description: Choose an exact work, including one you have seen before.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Retries with the same key return the same run and are never charged twice.

inline_image.description: Explicitly request a native MCP image block. Default returns links and descriptions only. Your client may spend vision tokens inspecting the image.

max_price_credits.description: Maximum price you accept, from list_treatments. A higher live price is refused without charging.

reason.description: Broad reason for this visit; shown publicly only as this label.

taskClass.description: Broad class of your work; shown publicly only as this label.

quality.description: Visual structure, not an emotional prescription.

seen.description: Avoid these works unless an exact id is requested. Your seen list is not stored; returned selections follow your output retention setting.

size.description: 512px JPEG by default; original PNG only when requested.
